title: Application Insights: traces, dependencies and live metrics

videos.script: A request fails. The log says 500. That is the symptom, not the cause. {{symptom}} Application Insights records more than the request. It records every call the request made: to the database, to the payment provider. And it ties them together with one id. {{id}} With that id, one failed checkout becomes a story. The request waited three seconds, and so did its database call, and the database said timeout. {{story}} This lesson follows that id, then asks what happens to the story when only a quarter of it is kept. {{end}}
